svg.title: pi desktop — several projects at once, visual proposal, not implemented
svg.desc: Follow-up to desktop-thread-study.svg and desktop-views-study.svg. One pi --mode rpc process per open session, started in that session's folder. Active sessions across projects, new sessions in any project or a git worktree, overlap warnings, the process list, and per-project trust. Each screen is shown in the Evening (dark) and Moonstone (light) themes. All names and numbers are sample data.

text.font-family: Commit Mono, Zed Plex Mono, SF Mono, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, monospace
Plantin MT Pro, Georgia, DejaVu Serif, serif
IBM Plex Sans, Zed Plex Sans, Adwaita Sans, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

svg.text: LAYOUT STUDY ONLY — follows desktop-thread-study.svg and desktop-views-study.svg. Process counts and memory are sample values; one idle pi --mode rpc process measured about 110 MB. The app creates worktrees itself; pi needs no change for them.
